decision_rule: Exploratory expanded 24-log screen, 24 paired logs x four arms, frozen corpus and pinned worker Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-Q8_0 and production-consolidated-v10 CPU kernel. The paired pilot observed verified-quote minus control +0.06458 accuracy; 24 independent pairs have worst-case paired standard error 0.204; source correlation can increase it, so do not claim a statistically established effect or promotion. Complete 96 unique matched cells with captured evidence and answer text, all parsed below 1024 tokens, unchanged control and 24/24 planted mismatch rejections: report arm accuracy, matched outcomes and retained evidence; compare verified-quote and control descriptively. Stop on invalid control/linkage, stopfile/deadline, 2700s cap or operational futility; incomplete/truncated/invalid captures are INCONCLUSIVE, never gate success. Original per-log reference is capped at ten failed IDs with substring matching; disclose this limit. Sample is exploratory and nonrepresentative. For a valid complete run, file descriptive PASS if verified-quote mean accuracy >= control; otherwise file descriptive FAIL/STOP for this scoped screen. Missing validity is INCONCLUSIVE; no significance or production decision. Report original 12 and added 12 separately as well as combined; reused pilot cases are not independent confirmation. Record source-campaign clusters and separate added cases by provenance; do not treat same-campaign cases as independent groups. Checkpoint after each verified-quote cell from the fourth onward; stop on declared operational futility or after the full 96-cell screen. This is not an interim success gate. Record exact-string failed-ID recall as a separate report-only companion to the primary substring scorer; preserve the capped-10 gold denominator and primary futility/decision rule. Report accepted quote versus fail-open fallback counts and refetch-request counts by arm; retain fallback cells in the primary denominator. R6 output contract: result_path contains R6 treatment cells only; load and verify out/results.r3-native.jsonl SHA-256 59b4358cfdb709bf3b14a0781803d6595080b3045c8c0133b830b3e836ba7266 plus the R6 result_path, then reconcile the seed union and require exactly 96 unique matched cells before any verdict. Separately inspect out/run-events.r6.jsonl and require a matching non-dryrun exec-ID preflight with valid linkage and unchanged control code plus a valid pass_complete event, in addition to seed integrity and treatment reconciliation. Preserve execution IDs, CPU affinities, and scratch spill-pointer roots. Split-run limitations apply; no single-execution comparison, served-latency claim, promotion, or production decision.
notes: Resume the same 24-case corpus using the immutable 24-control R3 seed; R5 produced zero non-dryrun treatment cells and is retained as predecessor history only. R5 recorded a dryrun=true preflight and qualifying dry-run cell but no non-dry-run treatment cell, so it is never native evidence. R6 native result_path starts empty; never merge the R3 seed or R5 dry-run rows into it. R6 writes its own fresh dry-run stream out/results.dryrun.r6.jsonl and own events out/run-events.r6.jsonl. Qualification requires exactly one new dryrun=true verified_quote cell in the R6 stream; job.py returns cleanly after that one cell without COMPLETE. Dry-run smoke evidence does not establish real execution. Any later verdict requires a separate matching non-dryrun preflight with valid linkage and unchanged control, valid pass_complete in R6 events, immutable R3 seed hash and 96-cell seed-plus-R6-treatment reconciliation. Preserve separate execution IDs, CPU affinities, and R3/R6 spill pointers. This is a split-run descriptive comparison; no served-latency claim. Source dependency: orch is an absolute symlink to the existing clean R5 detached git worktree at orch_pin 3a428cb3795b26251c5f111c9eaa887db0690994; R6 owns no second source checkout. The R5 manifest retains that source worktree under orch/**.
